seen.body:
## Behaviour
`qew pr open ITEM` opens a draft pull request on the item's issue mirror target, writes `mirrors/<ID>/<target>-pr-<N>.json` only after the forge accepted the create, and prints one terse line (`ID pr #N URL (draft)`). The PR is assigned to its opener (forge login from the actor) so a board and a reader see whose it is. `--json` prints a stable object (`item`, `number`, `url`, `draft`, `schema_version`). The PR title comes from the item title; the body carries the `<!-- qew:ID -->` marker and a short derived summary, never a closing keyword.

## Scenarios
- golden: claimed item with one issue mirror -> draft PR, assignee set to the opener, exactly one pr mirror file, line names number and url. Prevents: a PR opened with no ledger record, or recorded before the forge accepted it.
- trailing machine flag: `qew pr open ITEM --json` after the positional prints the stable JSON object. Prevents: agents parsing human text.
- forge failure leaves no mirror: ForgeUnavailable / ForgeAuth / ForgeRejected during open writes no pr mirror file and exits 1 with one line. Prevents: a phantom PR record that later merges the wrong number.
- item with zero or several issue mirrors: refused with the `qew sync` / `--target` hint, nothing opened. Prevents: a PR opened against an arbitrary mirror.

## Reference coverage
Reference pull-request lifecycle walk file: golden walk (title/body/assignee), trailing machine-output flag. 2 test functions.

## Qew today
Covered in part: `PrWalk.test_open_records_a_pull_request_mirror_without_a_closing_keyword` covers draft, head/base, no keyword and the pr mirror file. Missing: assignee on the PullRequestSpec (spec has no assignee field), `--json`, failure-leaves-no-mirror walk, zero/several mirror refusal walk. Reduced: `_mirror_for` uses a bare `next()` and would raise StopIteration if the mirror was removed from config.
seen.title: Cover `qew pr open` golden walk: draft PR, mirror file, opener assignee, JSON output
